connector.name: Mzizi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Read-only MCP over the Mzizi design system registry - nodes, components, ownership.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.mzizi.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mzizi-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nyuchi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
env.description: Public Supabase publishable (anon) key — RLS grants read-only access to component_documents.
